period_note: Solo (bank-only) Balance Sheet and Profit and Loss Account, read directly from the bank's own Q3-2019 unaudited financial statements. Like 2015_Q3, this filing is a single-page condensed 'newspaper advertisement' style disclosure with Consolidated Balance Sheet, Solo Balance Sheet and Solo Profit and Loss Account as three side-by-side panels -- but this particular scan is high-resolution and unambiguous, read directly from the page image (no OCR uncertainty). Comparative column (31 Dec 2018) reproduces this dataset's existing FY2018 figures exactly (total_assets 407227.40m, equity 44809.35m, nav_per_share 16.88). Income-statement items are CUMULATIVE from 1 January 2019 (first of four P&L columns: [Jan-Sep 2019] [Jan-Sep 2018] [Jul-Sep 2019 discrete] [Jul-Sep 2018 discrete]). Full identity chain confirmed exactly: Total Operating Income = NII + Investment Income + Commission + Other Income (9263.66m); Profit Before Provision = Total Op Income - Total Op Expenses (4412.98m); Profit Before Tax = PBP - Total Provision (3412.98m); PAT = PBT - Tax (1912.98m).
